onset.Description: Onset of the event relative to the first scanner trigger pulse.

duration.Description: Duration of the event. Equal to response time if the participant responded before the maximum display window elapsed; otherwise it is the maximum display window.

trial_type.Description: Type of event within the Reading the Mind in the Eyes task: eyes_trial for all participants.

Levels.eyes_trial: A trial in which a photograph of the eye region is presented and the participant selects the emotion or mental state that best describes the person.

response_time.Description: Time from stimulus onset to the participant's response; n/a if the participant did not respond

accuracy.Description: Whether the participant's response was correct.

stim_num.Description: Numeric identifier of the stimulus presented on the trial.

key_pressed.Description: Response key pressed by the participant. n/a if no response was made.

correct_response.Description: Correct response key for the stimulus.

key_position.Description: Position of the response option selected by the participant.

correct_position.Description: Position of the correct response option.

trial_num.Description: Sequential trial number within the task.
